text: Week four.
Nothing happens in week four.
Leila uses her kit, the color holds, and she doesn't think about us even once.
That's exactly what we want.
Because look at who's winning while she isn't even looking.
The salon keeps her client, who could have drifted away to a pharmacy box.
It earns on a visit it couldn't have made alone.
Our target is 10% more income for partner salons by 2030.
And the professional stays theirs, we don't hire her, we never will.
ServiceMarket gets something it can't buy,
the name of L'Oréal behind it and a door to salons it could never sign one by one.
And L'Oréal learns.
For the first time,
we see what our products do to real hair,
in real homes,
over 12 weeks,
not in a lab,
not in a survey.
That is worth more than the margin on any single visit.
Three partners, three different reasons to want this to work.
That's why it holds together.
